name: o2_stance_change_soak
purpose: Stance Change ends a Soak type (decision 0083 section 7): at step 1 Pelipper, p1b, soaks Aegislash, p2b (Water), whose Sacred Sword then turns it to Aegislash-Blade: formeChange calls setSpecies, which resets the types (sim/pokemon.ts:1387-1392), so Incineroar's Flare Blitz is super effective against Steel/Ghost again. The engine kept the Water type. A battle of the doubles differential campaign of decision 0083 section 7 (tools/reference/diff_driver.py random, seed 90, two Reg M-C teams, its battle 282), cut after its step 1: adopted as the regression fixture of that fix. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
